mapper.select: select bnd_company_id from t_cmp_binding where bnd_user_id = #{userId} and bnd_status = 1 limit 1
select user_id from sys_user where phonenumber = #{phone} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id from sys_user where email = #{email} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select nick_name from sys_user where user_id = #{userId}
select tal_id as talId, tal_resume_id as resumeId from t_tal where tal_user_id = #{userId} and tal_company_id = #{companyId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_tal (tal_user_id, tal_company_id, tal_status) values (#{userId}, #{companyId}, 0)
mapper.update: update t_tal set tal_resume_id = #{resumeId} where tal_id = #{talId}
